summary: The frozen source exposed tail 36 at 2/15 completion (13.3%). Three independent 92,160-transition PPO trials then achieved 25/27 frozen clears (92.6%) at tail 36 while retaining 25/27 at tail 32, with every optimizer trial and all three game seeds represented, finite losses, and zero controller restarts. This accepts the retained boss-curriculum expansion but remains assisted, training-seed evidence rather than normal-start Zone 2 promotion.
